The '''Conjo Y41-4LC fighter''' was a type of [[Conjo fighter]] built by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] for planetary defense forces. Compared to other variants, the Y41-4LC was armed with four fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] capable of hitting targets two kilometers distant, along with a larger power generator and more advanced targeting computer. This combination made it an adept high-altitude air superiority fighter.<ref name="TABSB" />
